title.purpose: The page title, one per page.

lead.purpose: Section titles; the machine name at the head of a stacked row; the tagline under Sign in.

base.purpose: Body text, table cells, buttons and nav links.

meta.purpose: Labels, hints, table headers, small buttons, back links, footer.

figure.purpose: IDs, addresses, percentages and sizes: anything compared digit by digit. Tabular numerals.

wordmark.purpose: The name Lemnos in the bar.

wordmark-greek.purpose: ΛΗΜΝΟΣ beside the wordmark. This lockup only; decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

shadows.name: heat-track-hairline
shadows.purpose: A 1px edge around a heat track. The only shadow declaration; nothing casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Easing for the heat strips drawing in.

motion.name: heat-in
motion.purpose: Each heat strip uncovers once from the left on load. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover and focus. Nothing changes size or position.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Below: nav drops to a second line, theme switch moves from the bar to the footer, gutters 1rem.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: From here a form sits beside its table in a fixed 24rem column.

breakpoints.name: table
breakpoints.purpose: Below: stacking tables become blocks in as many columns as fit at a 21rem minimum.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: From here heat tracks widen from 6rem to 9rem.

focus.purpose: One keyboard focus ring for everything; shell ink on the bar; flush (offset 0) on inputs.

pageWidths.name: page
pageWidths.purpose: Pages of tables; also the bar and footer.

narrative.overview:
Machines are Hephaistos's bronzes. One in use stays polished, one left idle grows a patina, and how hard it works is read as the heat the metal has run to. The whole system is that one reading: a deep verdigris bar across the top, a green-black or pale green-grey ground beneath it, polished bronze wherever something is running or waiting to be pressed, sea-green patina wherever something has been left alone.

It is an operating console, so it is dense and flat. Pages are a title, one line about the page, then full-width tables with 40px rows. Bordered panels hold a single form or a single group of settings and nothing else. There are no shadows, no cards used as layout, four type sizes and one corner radius. Greece is felt, not illustrated: the bronze and the verdigris, the island's name set small in Greek capitals beside the wordmark, and a text face drawn by a Greek designer.

Both modes are first-class. Every colour is one token holding a light value and a dark value, switched by the page's colour scheme, so nothing is styled twice. The bar and the heat scale are the same in both modes.
keyCharacteristics: A verdigris bar on every page, identical in light and dark.
A tinted ground: green-black in dark, cool pale green-grey in light, never neutral grey or cream.
Bronze for what is in use, patina for what is idle, cinnabar for failure and nothing else.
Load drawn as a heat strip clipped from one fixed gradient, so rows compare by eye.
State shown as a mark and a word; the marks differ in shape as well as colour.
Flat surfaces, hairline rules, 4px corners, 40px rows, four type sizes.

rules.name: The Two Metals Rule
rules.body: Bronze means in use, patina means idle. A running machine, a switched-on setting and an online node take the bronze disc; a stopped machine and a switched-off setting take the patina ring. Never swap them and never add a third "healthy" colour.

rules.name: The Failure-Only Red Rule
rules.body: At rest, cinnabar appears only where something has failed: a failure notice, an unreachable mark, an inline error. Stop, Remove and Turn off look like any other button until pointed at or focused, so a red notice is never one of many red things on the page.

rules.name: The Heat Stays In The Strip Rule
rules.body: The five heat colours are never used for text, fills, marks or decoration. Straw for "paused" comes from the warning token, not from the scale.

rules.name: The Tinted Ground Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans green. No neutral grey, no cream, no pure black ground.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: Title, lead, base, meta. The default type scale is removed from the build, so a size outside these four generates nothing. Hierarchy comes from weight and ink strength before it comes from size.

rules.name: The Digits Rule
rules.body: Mono is only for things compared digit by digit: IDs, addresses and figures. Names, labels and prose are never mono.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: The bar reads "Lemnos" (700, 1.125rem, tracking -0.01em) followed by ΛΗΜΝΟΣ (500, 0.8125rem, tracking 0.16em, shell-muted), on one baseline. Wide tracking and Greek capitals belong to this lockup only; the Greek is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

rules.name: The Flat Metal Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, no glows, no blur, at rest or on hover. A thing is raised by being lighter than its ground and lowered by being darker; hover changes tone, never height.

rules.name: The One Corner Rule
rules.body: Containers and controls share the 4px radius. No pills, no large rounded cards.

dos: Do use the bronze fill for the single action that moves things forward, and the bronze disc for anything running, on or online.
Do show state as a mark plus a word, and give a new state its own shape, not just its own colour.
Do show load with the heat strip and put the exact figure beside it in mono.
Do make destructive buttons look ordinary at rest and turn cinnabar only on hover and focus.
Do define a colour once as a light and dark pair and let the colour scheme pick; the bar and heat scale stay the same in both modes.
Do keep to the four sizes, the 4px corner and the 40px row.
Do give every stacking table cell its column name, so the row still explains itself as a block below 75rem.
Do report a failure as a notice in plain words with the technical reason folded beneath it.
Do keep targets at least 40px tall where rows stack and where the theme switch sits in the footer.
donts: Don't put cinnabar on anything at rest that has not failed.
Don't use the heat colours outside a load strip.
Don't colour table links bronze; in tables they are ink with an underline.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or blur.
Don't nest panels, or build a page out of panels where a table or plain text would do.
Don't use a neutral grey, cream or pure black ground.
Don't set names, labels or prose in mono, or add a fifth type size.
Don't animate anything except the heat strips drawing in once on load and 150ms colour changes on hover and focus.
Don't use a green dot for "running"; green here means idle.
Don't reuse the tracked Greek capitals of the wordmark as a label style elsewhere.
